notes.title: Development Log: July/August
notes.notes: [h2]Double Row Build Menu[/h2][p]Since some categories have a lot of objects to select from, the build menu now shows two rows. This will make it easier for you to find the right decoration to place or tree to plant.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/8c9d2aaee67654fe92c634eba7a9b85414f99241.png"][/img][/p][h2]No More?[/h2][p]That's it for the past months. Why? We welcomed our second child into this world, which took all of our time. Hopefully I will have more time to add new things in the coming months.[/p]

notes.title: Development Log: May/June
notes.notes:
[h2]Better Decorations[/h2][p]Previously, objects could only be rotated every 90 degree. This is now changed to every 2 degree. This means you will be able to place objects with greater detail.
Speaking of greater details, you can conquer water with a Pier. Simply place a pier and the water and get a full and valid tile to place objects on!
And to help with selecting objects to place, the UI now uses tabs instead of a single-weirdly long scroll bar. [i]Note: This might not be the final iteration of this Object-Placement-UI[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/4ab636bf94077f8dc8869ec3c2c5e053c7c81213.png"][/img][/p][h2]Basic Tutorial[/h2][p]Basically, what the title says, a basic tutorial. If you are new to the game and you want to help with the controls and gameplay, this tutorial popup will help guide you![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/c757b3911b9afe226cf3749a1f879d0576c493c8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]UI Overhaul[/h2][p]Every UI element has been looked at, changes have been considered and things have changed!
Buttons are rounded, windows have color and popup will pop more. Pun intended.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/f5582cb5a4453f1316fb91fe12dea9b0091c57ca.png"][/img][/p][h2]More Optimizations[/h2][p]In the last devlog, some basic optimizations were made and this devlog I have enabled a feature to gain 2.5x FPS! Instead of getting 60 FPS, it's now closer to 180 FPS!
[i]To be technical: I have enabled Unity's Resident Drawer. This changes how the game renders objects, it uses Instanced Rendering.[/i][/p][p]Enjoy the performance testing world's madness:
[i]Why? Because a lot of unique objects are harder for the game to render than a lot of the same objects.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/7e687ca354a0aeebaa6e0bd814347934f460bffa.png"][/img][/p][h2]More fixes[/h2][p]After upgrading to Unity 6.1, a lot of lighting and rendering was broken. Luckily this is now fixed.
Other than that, a lot of features have received polish, getting the game closer to a demo![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/4ce194c1ae7d50f4bc2da2b857e6c305171a90e8.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Development Log: March/April
notes.notes:
[h2]Photo Mode[/h2]
From some research I've done on similar games, the community tends to show their creations. A photo mode will give you -the community- more control over your screenshots. To share your wonderful worlds from it's best side!

You can fly around freely, change depth of field and other effects and take a screenshot of your own Mini World ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/78277dfa51410cf3f66a8649ba9cd689e7699a47.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/79644529e1db1f1e769cd50abdd1872c3988d88a.png[/img]

[h2]New Pathfinding[/h2]
Before, every tile had a pathfinding node which would lead to very bulky paths and would not allow for differences in townsfolk behavior. With the new pathfinding, objects you place will determine the nodes which will make the townsfolk a lot more believable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/0de6d28ad65a104a1089fd597cc1ab1b8635222a.png[/img]

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
When some of you will fill an entire world with the most epic cities and detailed parks, the amount of objects and townsfolk will cause performance issues. To avoid these issues early on, some optimizations were made to still allow for above 60 FPS gameplay with a filled world

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/4349aedb5c93bacaf5245d9f13f8b1b3cdfcb090.png[/img]

[h2]Lots of Bug Fixes[/h2]
When creating a game, a developer wants to get features in quick to test if they are fun or not. This leads to funky implementations more often than we would like, with more bugs than we would like. Luckily I've already addressed the bulk of these bugs. Now let's hope you won't find more :P

Hopefully I will have more news on a demo really soon! For now, enjoy some new decorations you can place, like lumber :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/b4270942dcbef8f205c8c314c24284a6ce07e5a6.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Log: February
notes.notes:
[h2]New Save Data[/h2]
Before, all of the save data was stored in a single file. This made it tricky to get specific information that would only be visible in the loading screen, like your world's name. As of right now, the save data is put into separate files and with a screenshot as well. This makes the new loading window look very nice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/10b55287257f359e6a6abbda57fd3037084645ca.gif[/img]

[h2]Preparations[/h2]
Development for some features have started but are not ready yet, like:
A [b]photo mode[/b]. A camera with more motion, to get that perfect screenshot!
[b]Pier and bridge[/b] objects. Build a foundation to build 'on water'.
[b]Controller support[/b]. This might sound weird for a town builder, but I like my games to be playable with a controller as well.

[h1]Did you say Demo?[/h1]
Generating the just the right worlds, building cities of your dreams and sharing screenshots with the community is what Mini Worlds is about and the demo will have it all. Not all features and buildable objects will be available in the demo but it will give a great sense of what you can create in the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/d8f67dd61fa03f7c2d0bc71e854570abea8906e9.gif[/img]

notes.title: Development Log: January
notes.notes:
I hope everyone had a great Christmas holiday and a happy new year. I took some time off game development and focused on family. Now that the new year has started, so did I start with some changes.

[h2]Devlog 1[/h2]
From now on, I will make small video devlogs on changes made to Mini Worlds:
[previewyoutube=ku1Aix6FWcs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Free Placement[/h2]
In the development log from October, I've mentioned decorations. A different system to add some extra objects to a tile to decorate your buildings. I've now turned both the building system and decoration system into one. During development, I only have to specify if it's a free placement object and the placement system will do its thing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/705203c5e9f33bf6b4e8d194a42c8a595e1e533b.png[/img]

[h2]Particles[/h2]
To make the feature of adding objects to the world feel a lot better, I've added particle effects to it up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/471285ac7233c7d4b664aaf0c8e6c43009f702bb.gif[/img]

[h2]New Tree Generation[/h2]
Previously, the trees were special made objects containing 3 trees. This meant that with world generation, it could only place those clumps of trees. So now, with the new 'free placement' system, 1, 2 or 3 trees can be generated. This makes the world generation feel a little more natural.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/d0ad41cca154b015fc34f95a83592e7bf9eaefbf.png[/img]

[h2]Farming[/h2]
New objects have been added related to farming. Cabbages, Pumpkings, Corn and new fences.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/e1e95eb4fbbf2697b0829d5ffc802860ce08a35d.png[/img]

[h2]General Polish[/h2]
[list]
[*]The 'delete' mode can remove a single object or an entire tile worth of objects.
[*]Deletion Mode is more appealing with a new highlighting renderer.
[*]The placement menu can now be scrolled through.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/ea1545972d061172fb24f781f04a80fa2746edc7.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Log: October
notes.notes:
[h1]1. Audio[/h1]
As the header suggests, audio has been added to the game. Either when placing a building, wheat field or removing trees, you'll be able to get an audio cue.
If you want to hear the new sound effects, head over to the [url=https://discord.gg/UmUEbyw]Discord[/url] and take a look in the #mini-worlds-dev channel.

[h1]2. Decorations[/h1]
This is the main feature this month and required a rework of a lot of major systems. But now, you'll be able to place smaller decorations next to 'main' objects.
Want to add a fence or hedge to a house, that can be done.
Are you into cliffs? Simple place rocks along a shoreline.
This unlocked a whole lot of possibilities unimagined before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/8865ff1369adeedfdc850728a20ee43892fbf490.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/705203c5e9f33bf6b4e8d194a42c8a595e1e533b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/f8e1fdf86ecd5292965860b24a8c5cd8a92d61e9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/42b5ff12cfb8962d385eaf6b1ac4b8f887d0b986.png[/img]

If you have suggestions for buildings, features or anything else, Join the [url=https://discord.gg/UmUEbyw]Discord[/url] and head to the 'suggestions' channel.

That was October. Stay tuned for another Development Log in November!

notes.title: Development Log: September
notes.notes:
[h1]1. Villagers[/h1]
As can read in the previous article, villagers were added because I thought the world felt a little empty. When making the announcement trailer, nothing was happening despite there being numerous buildings.
Now, every house will spawn 1 or 2 villagers who will walk around town. This is a great first step into making the world feel more alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/a7b9b2931f30c7005f8e04085a8742b547e0b858.png[/img]

[h1]2. Terraforming[/h1]
The world generation can give you a great looking world but sometimes you want to adjust a tile by yourself. Well, I'm working on such a tool. Currently, it's only a single tile, but that will change soon™

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/2658da2fa016236e92243b6d8b045f4ef68a97cf.gif[/img]

[h1]3. Dragging[/h1]
Already a Quality of Life feature! When developing or making screenshots, it was very tedious to keep clicking when building a town. So now, simply drag a building, road or tree across the world and it will be placed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/c72e80bfd27866e9e921683c8ffc0f80fb876ef0.gif[/img]

If you have suggestions for buildings, features or anything else, Join the [url=https://discord.gg/UmUEbyw]Discord[/url] and head to the 'suggestions' channel.

That was September. Stay tuned for another Development Log in October!
